description: geonoise.mmap.ro: airport and aviation datasets is a collection of datasets listed in the INIS Geoportal of Romania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geonoise.mmap.ro. Coverage: the area served by geonoise.mmap.ro. The listing groups 3 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about airport and aviation; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: DF1_5 Major Airports GeoPackage_download service; DF1_5 Major Airports GeoPackage_view service; DF1_5 Major Airports GeoPackage. Formats seen: WMS, ATOM. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/conditionsUnknown). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-inis.
